title: 4-player clarity: make it obvious that up to 4 people can play
problem: The owner couldn't find how to play with 4 people. Online, the lobby says 'Invite a friend', shows one empty row ('Waiting for a friend to join') and a small grey '1/4'. On the same phone, 4 people means picking 3 rival shops and switching each to Friend, which nothing explains. 4-person online rooms work (checked 2026-10-26: four joined and played, a fifth was refused 'This room is full').

approval.evidence: Approve PLAN-005 only, including its listed tests and documentation

scope: Online lobby: heading 'Invite friends (up to 3)'; a clear 'Players 1 of 4' count; one row per open seat ('Open seat: send the link'); when full, 'Room full: start when everyone is ready'
Home screen: a small line under 'Play a friend': '2 to 4 players online'
Quick match screen: one line 'Quick match is always 2 players. For 3 or 4, use Play a friend.'
New game screen: a line under 'Rival shops': 'Up to 4 shops. Pick Friend to pass this phone around.' and a total like '4 shops: you, 2 friends, 1 computer'
Automated 4-person online test added to the browser suite
exclusions: Rules, balance, the 4-player limit, quick match size
Button labels used to navigate (kept so links and tests keep working)

acceptance.text: Lobby shows 'Players N of 4' and one open-seat row per free seat; numbers update as people join and when computer shops are added
acceptance.evidence: e2e-four: host alone "Players 1 of 4" with 3 open seats; after Ben joined and +1 AI "Players 3 of 4", 1 open seat and "Invite friends (up to 2)"

acceptance.text: With 4 people, no open seats remain and the lobby says the room is full
acceptance.evidence: e2e-four: 4 people "Players 4 of 4", 0 open seats, "Room full · start when everyone is ready"

acceptance.text: A new browser test: 4 people join one room, all see the game, a 5th is refused
acceptance.evidence: e2e-four: 5th person sees "This room is full"; all 4 reached the game with 3 rivals each

acceptance.text: Home, quick match and new game screens show the new lines on a 360 px wide phone without overflow (screenshots)
acceptance.evidence: 360 px screenshots of home, online and new game: no overflow (page width 360 of 360); total line "4 shops: you, 2 friends, 1 computer"

acceptance.text: Store screenshots change only where intended (home and lobby text)
acceptance.evidence: Store screenshots vs cc27848: home 7.28% (intended: Play a friend gains a second line), all 6 game screens 0.00%

acceptance.text: verify:full green in CI; no rules, server or save changes
acceptance.evidence: CI run 11 (40309845202) on 04b72b5 green, including the four-player step; preview updated. No rules, server or save files changed

added: Open-seat rows and a 'Room full' line in the online lobby
Hints on the home, online and new-game screens
Automated test: four players in one room
changed: Lobby wording: 'Invite friends (up to 3)' and 'Players 1 of 4' (computer shops count toward the 4)

playerNotes: Clearer group play: the online lobby now shows how many of the 4 seats are taken, with open seats to fill, and the menus explain that 2 to 4 people can play together (online, or passing one phone)
